description: This file defines data models and database entities for a calendar and astrology app, including entities for calendar events, leaves, and astrology details, as well as corresponding data classes and enums.

classes.name: EventType
classes.description: Enumeration of supported event types in the calendar, such as LEAVE and HOLIDAY.

classes.name: LeaveType
classes.description: Enumeration of leave types like PERSONAL, SICK, and CASUAL.

classes.name: CalendarEventEntity
classes.description: Room database entity representing a calendar event, stored in 'calendar_events' table.

classes.name: LeaveEntity
classes.description: Room database entity for leave entries, stored in 'leaves' table.

classes.name: AstrologyEntity
classes.description: Room database entity for astrology details, stored in 'astrology_details' table.
